detailed_description:
The whole video adopts semi-realistic Chinese fantasy 3D-CG virtual human aesthetic standard, 60% realistic foundation matched with 40% gentle beautification, UE5 rendering activated with ray tracing Lumen, ambient occlusion AO, skin subsurface scattering SSS, PBR physical materials, smooth character skeletal animation, translucent realistic skin texture, cinematic dynamic lighting, 8K ultra-high precision detail.
[Shot 1] Duration 00:00.000 - 00:03.000, extremely wide establishing shot of Zhuge Manor backyard on spring thunderstorm night, deep depth of field. The illuminated ancient locust trunk and green tile eaves remain sharp and clear, sky and frame corners maintain underexposed dark night tone to build layered brightness contrast. Centered symmetrical frame composition, giant ancient locust tree stands on vertical central axis, twisting branches naturally form frame border, green tile eaves create horizontal dividing line at lower 1/3 frame, thunderstorm sky occupies upper two-thirds of screen. The camera executes extremely slow forward push movement. Thick thunderclouds cover sky without moonlight, base environmental tone is near-black indigo blue, underexposed by 3 stops. At 00:00.000 - 00:01.200: The courtyard is almost engulfed by darkness, only faint dark silhouette of locust branches and roof tiles can be distinguished, slanting rain threads are invisible within shadow. At 00:01.200: A horizontal branched 6500K cool white lightning rips open the sky, harsh hard light illuminates locust canopy, branch texture and green tile roof edges; inclined rain threads show as silver lines under lightning radiation, ground remains dim shadow. At 00:01.500, lightning reaches brightness peak then gradually fades. At 00:02.000, a weaker residual secondary flash briefly lights up only the silhouette of ancient locust tree. From 00:02.000 to 00:03.000, frame slowly falls back to dark indigo night, ancient locust returns to dark silhouette. Continuous fine rain falls with 20-degree inclination driven by wind; ancient locust branches and leaves sway slightly in gusts. A faint cool white light halo slowly dissipates for 0.3s after each lightning strike. No human characters appear in this shot.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000 cut transition, duration 00:03.000 - 00:05.500, full-body medium shot inside the same thunderstorm backyard, shallow depth of field. Camera focus firmly locks onto <Subject 3> whole body; distant courtyard walls and window lantern light are softly blurred into circular warm orange bokeh glow. Dynamic rule-of-thirds composition, <Subject 3> starts at the right 1/3 of frame and sprints left toward open courtyard space; ancient locust trunk serves as vertical dividing line. Slightly shaky handheld horizontal tracking shot, camera movement speed synchronizes with <Subject 3> running pace, subtle vertical jitter, no push, pull or lift movement. Base environment tone is dark indigo night underexposed by 2 stops, puddles on bluestone reflect scattered cool light; faint warm orange lamplight leaks from distant inner hall windows. Intermittent cool lightning sweeps across courtyard, cold and warm light alternately cast onto character body. At 00:03.000 - 00:03.300: <Subject 3> rushes out abruptly from inner hall side door, torso leans sharply forward, skirt flutters, splashes rise when feet step on accumulated rainwater. At 00:03.300 - 00:04.800: She staggers and runs left across courtyard, strands of hair blown messy by wind; facial brightness switches rapidly as body blocks light source, expressing flustered urgency. At 00:04.200, <Subject 3> (S1) shouts anxiously: <d>[Chinese] 老爷！夫人生了！是位小公子！</d>. At 00:04.800 - 00:05.500, she keeps sprinting forward, slanting rain threads become visible under alternating light. Fine inclined rain persists, raindrops splash on stone ground, thin mist floats in air.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500 cut transition, duration 00:05.500 - 00:08.000, interior of Eastern Han wooden study during thunderstorm night, shot shifts from extreme close-up to medium shot, shallow depth of field. Focus locks on bamboo slips in early phase, candle flame blurs into circular bokeh; focus smoothly shifts to eye area of <Subject 4> afterward, study background stays blurred all time. Camera position fixed, slowly tilts upward 12 degrees uniformly when <Subject 4> stands up. Cold indigo night light with mist seeps through window gaps; 2700K warm orange hard light radiates from bronze desktop candle, forming strong contrast between cold and warm lighting, candle flame sways irregularly nonstop. At 00:05.500 - 00:06.200, extreme close-up shot showing bamboo slips sliding off wooden desk and scattering across tabletop. At 00:06.200 - 00:07.500, camera tilts upward and switches to medium shot, <Subject 4> suddenly stands straight, half of his face illuminated by candlelight. At 00:07.500 - 00:08.000, <Subject 4> stands still, gaze forward with shocked expression; candlelight creates sharp highlight inside his pupils, shadow of figure trembles gently on wall. <Subject 4> (S2) speaks in stunned trembling tone: <d>[Chinese] 生了？！</d>. Floating dust particles illuminated by candlelight drift through air, thin rain mist drifts inward from window slits.
overall_soundscape:
Persistent ambient base sound runs through all three shots: continuous fine pattering rainfall, intermittent low-frequency wind roar, rustling tree leaves sound. Lightning thunder sound exists in [Shot 1]; running footsteps, water splash and maid’s heavy breathing overlay in [Shot 2]; indoor candle burning noise, bamboo slip impact sound and fabric friction sound continue in [Shot 3].
